svg.text: service road: tug trains with bag carts
ARRIVALS CORRIDOR: arriving passengers never meet departing ones
seats by each gate, window seats, charging points, toilets
duty free, food court, bar, play area, lounge
trays, scanners, bag search, fast track
desk islands with their own queues, bag drop
carousels, first and last bag times
meeters, car hire, taxis, hotel desk
